description: Returns what each of the three self-serve account plans includes (Enterprise is not listed): daily search allowance, results per search, saved searches and alert frequency, how soon new listings appear, multi-query search and foundation research depth, and the number of searches in the search-credit add-on. Prices and terms are not included; the answer gives the address of the pricing page, where they are shown. No inputs. Does not count toward the search allowance.
